authority: One separately reviewed authorization may account only its exact bounded accepted-inventory slot list. It grants no lifecycle, deployment, cleanup, traffic, fitting, evaluation, reopening, replacement, or expansion authority.
commitment: Exclusive durable reservation is followed by a post-fsync validity observation, ADMITTED and CONSUMED before any slot event. Partial reservation is permanently spent. The decision bundle is published after all target events.

prerequisites.NOT_RUN_OPERATIONAL_FAILURE: Independently verified preceding pair member or campaign operational/cleanup failure that prevents the target from starting; cleanup success is not required when cleanup failure is the blocker.
prerequisites.NOT_RUN_ENVIRONMENT_DRIFT: Exact expected epoch and independently observed mismatching epoch evidence; accounting grants no authority to resume.
prerequisites.NOT_RUN_DEVELOPMENT_INCONCLUSIVE: Independently closed development accounting with accepted progression criteria unsatisfied.
prerequisites.NOT_RUN_UNUSABLE_MODEL: Durable consumed development-freeze action failed its fixed model/freeze requirements without publishing a usable freeze.

target_rule: Every target must be an exact accepted slot with an absent accounting directory and run root. Any reservation, consumption, runtime artifact, or terminal rejects the whole action.
artifact_rule: NOT_RUN targets contain only precommitted identity, assignment, source/epoch/reason/evidence bindings, and the accounting event. Measurements, predictor rows, method outputs, and predictions are forbidden.
